name: Can I replace my countertops without replacing my cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my countertops without replacing my cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can often replace countertops without replacing your existing cabinets, provided your cabinets are structurally sound and in good condition. During the replacement process, care is taken to remove the old countertops without damaging the cabinet frames. However, if your cabinets are unstable, warped, or significantly damaged, their replacement or repair might be recommended to ensure a solid foundation for your new countertops. Frasheski Construction assesses cabinet integrity during the initial consultation to advise on the best approach for your project in areas like El Cerrito.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, countertops can be replaced without changing cabinets if cabinets are structurally sound. We assess cabinet integrity to ensure a solid foundation.
